keycloakHostname.description: The Keycloak host kore derives (ADR 0113, ADR 0133): keycloak.<organizationId>.<platformDomain> while platform-shared-gateway is on, keycloak.<platformDomain> otherwise. The portal's OIDC issuer takes the same value.

sharedGateway.description: The shared platform Gateway the Keycloak route attaches to, which kore passes only while platform-shared-gateway is on (ADR 0133). Without it no route renders.

features.description: Kore passes the environment's feature flags here (ADR 0077). Only platform-portal is read: on, the Organization composition also owns the realm.
